props.gloss_en: does our father know of this anguish?
how would he know? -- the dead father does not know of his sons' anguish
for it is written: 'his sons are honoured and he does not know' (Job 14:21)
and does he not know? but it is written: 'only his flesh upon him pains, and his soul upon him mourns' (Job 14:22)
R' Yitzchak: the worm is as hard to the dead as a needle in living flesh
of their own pain they know
of others' pain they do not know
the baraita (the pious man in the cemetery, third year): one spirit to the other: my friend, leave me -- the words between me and you have already been heard among the living
Ze'iri's dead innkeeper: go take them [the coins] from under the door-hinge in such a place, and tell my mother to send me my comb and my tube of eye-paint with so-and-so who comes tomorrow
Shmuel's dead father: why do you weep? -- because you are coming [here] soon
R' Yonatan: do they [the dead] know so much? but it is written 'and the dead know nothing' (Eccl 9:5)
whence that the dead converse with one another?
as it says: 'and the Lord said to him: this is the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac and to Jacob, saying' (Deut 34:4)
what is 'saying'? The Holy One said to Moses: go say to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob: the oath I swore to you I have already fulfilled for your children
(entertained) if it should enter your mind that they do not know
(inside the assumption) when he tells them, what of it?
rather, they know
R' Yitzchak: whoever speaks after the dead is as if he speaks after a stone
some say: because they do not know
and some say: they know, and it does not matter to them
Rav Pappa: one man spoke [ill] after Mar Shmuel, and a reed fell from the roof and split his skull
whoever speaks after the bier of Torah scholars falls into Gehinnom
as it says: 'and those who turn aside to their crooked ways, the Lord will lead them with the workers of iniquity; peace upon Israel' (Ps 125:5)
even at a time when there is peace upon Israel, 'the Lord will lead them with the workers of iniquity'
if you saw a Torah scholar transgress at night, do not think [ill] after him by day -- perhaps he repented
and this applies to matters of his own body; but in money -- until he returns it to its owner

objections.gloss_en: ולא ידע? והא כתיב אך בשרו עליו יכאב ונפשו עליו תאבל, ואמר רבי יצחק קשה רמה למת כמחט בבשר החי -- the dead feel pain, so they know (kind svara under protest: no ObjectionKind names the והא כתיב verse-contradiction)

answered_by.gloss_en: דלמא דומה קדים ומכריז להו -- perhaps Duma comes first and announces it to them
